test_title: PYST 10: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 07 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can replace the underlined segment in the given sentence.

A __false and selfish friend__ will never be by your side in times of difficulty.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Fair weather friend)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term **"fair weather friend"** refers to someone who is only a friend during good times but is unreliable and disappears when things get tough. (सुख-दुःख में साथ न देने वाला दोस्त) • **Example:** When I lost my job, I realized that my colleague was just a **fair weather friend** who stopped helping me. • Explanation of the phrase in the given sentence: The sentence highlights the idea of a selfish friend who abandons you in times of difficulty. A "fair weather friend" perfectly fits this description. (ऐसा दोस्त जो केवल अच्छे समय में आपके साथ हो।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Fair weather friend)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Great hand** (उत्कृष्ट सहायक): Refers to someone who is very skilled or helpful. • **Example:** She is a **great hand** at organising events and managing teams. • **Past master** (विशेषज्ञ): Refers to someone who is highly skilled or experienced in a particular field. • **Example:** He is a **past master** at solving complex mathematical problems. • **Good Samaritan** (सहायक व्यक्ति): Refers to a person who selflessly helps others in need. • **Example:** A **good Samaritan** helped the injured man by calling an ambulance. 39:Tcf3, The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Banter)**.
